records.title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters (EMJM)
records.deadline_display: In most cases, you should submit your application between October and January for courses starting the following academic year.

source.publisher: European Commission, Directorate-General for Education, Youth, Sport and Culture (Erasmus+ programme site)
source.as_of: Page last updated 26 June 2025; describes the annual intake cycle generically, with no cycle-specific year
source.raw_extract:
When to apply

A new batch of selected Erasmus Mundus Masters is added to the list each year.

In most cases, you should submit your application between October and January for courses starting the following academic year.

Each master's website has all the details about the course of study, the list of the participating universities, the entry requirements and all the steps of the application process (with and without scholarship).
source.exact_deadline_wording: In most cases, you should submit your application between October and January for courses starting the following academic year.
source.notes: Official European Commission programme page for EMJM. It publishes a two-month application WINDOW (October to January), not a fixed calendar deadline, so per brief section 6 this is MONTH with null deadline_date; no day was invented. Independently corroborated by the EACEA catalogue page, which uses the same October-January window, so there is no conflict. Students apply directly to each consortium; per-programme deadlines are set by each master's own website and are not published by the European Commission.

records.title: Erasmus+ Student Exchange (Studying Abroad)
records.deadline_display: There's no central application form to study abroad with Erasmus+. You can reach out to the international or Erasmus+ office of your university or higher education institution to start the process.

source.publisher: European Commission, Directorate-General for Education, Youth, Sport and Culture (Erasmus+ programme site)
source.raw_extract:
How to apply

There's no central application form to study abroad with Erasmus+.

You can reach out to the international or Erasmus+ office of your university or higher education institution to start the process.

Your sending higher education institution is obliged to select applicants in a fair and transparent way.
source.exact_deadline_wording: (none - the page states no deadline, no application window and no rolling basis)
source.notes: The official page confirms there is no central EU-level application route, but it never uses the words rolling, year-round or no fixed deadline, and it gives no application window. Brief section 6 allows ROLLING only where the source explicitly says rolling / no fixed deadline, so this stays UNKNOWN rather than being upgraded to ROLLING. The shard's stated 'typically 1-3 months before departure' was not confirmed by any official page and was not written. Each sending institution publishes its own Erasmus+ selection deadlines per academic year, which are not derivable from any EU-level page.

field_mapping.deadline_display: No central deadline published; applications are handled by the sending institution.

records.title: University of Southern Denmark (SDU) Danish Government Scholarship
records.deadline_display: You must submit your application for admission no later than February 1 - even if you have a Danish residence permit (master level) / You must submit your application for admission no later than March 15 (bachelor level)

source.as_of: Undated standing policy page (no intake year stated anywhere on the page)
source.raw_extract:
Application and selection criteria – bachelor level

To be considered for the scholarship you simply apply for admission to one or more of the relevant programmes. No separate scholarship application is needed.

#### To be eligible for a scholarship, please note: 

-   You must submit your application for admission no later than March 15 
-   Applicants with the highest score in the online admission test (uniTEST) will be invited to an interview.
...

Application and selection criteria – master level

#### To be eligible for a scholarship, please note:

-   You must submit your application for admission no later than February 1 - even if you have a Danish residence permit
source.exact_deadline_wording: You must submit your application for admission no later than February 1 - even if you have a Danish residence permit / You must submit your application for admission no later than March 15
source.notes: The shard's official_source_url (https://www.sdu.dk/en/uddannelse/tuition-fees-and-scholarships) returns HTTP 404; the live canonical page was located via SDU's Fees and Funding navigation. The page states two fixed month-and-day cut-offs (1 February for master's, 15 March for bachelor's) but attaches no year to either, and describes them as a standing, repeating selection rule ('Interviews will take place between February 19 and 27', 'Interviews will take place in early June'). Per brief section 6 this is ANNUAL / precision recurring, and the dates were NOT converted into a calendar deadline such as 2027-02-01. Note also that these are admission-application deadlines used for scholarship eligibility, not a separate scholarship deadline: 'No separate scholarship application is needed.'

records.title: Killam Fellowships Program (Fulbright Canada)
records.deadline_display: The deadline for the open competition for the 2027-28 Killam Fellowships competition is January 31, 2027.

source.publisher: Fulbright Canada, Foundation for Educational Exchange between Canada and the United States of America
source.as_of: 2027-28 Killam Fellowships competition; page banner reads 'COMPETITION OPEN on AUGUST 15, 2026'
source.raw_extract:
COMPETITION OPEN on AUGUST 15, 2026

The deadline for the open competition for the 2027-28 Killam Fellowships competition is January 31, 2027. If you are a student at one of our partner institutions and you are planning to apply to the direct exchange program, you are encouraged to contact a study abroad advisor at your institution to identify the date on which your institution's internal competition ends. All partner institutions have internal deadlines. Please consult the relevant officials at your home university.
source.exact_deadline_wording: The deadline for the open competition for the 2027-28 Killam Fellowships competition is January 31, 2027.
source.notes: IMPORTANT SCOPE CAVEAT for downstream use: 2027-01-31 is the deadline for the OPEN COMPETITION route only. The Program has two routes and the direct exchange route has no single date - each home institution sets its own internal deadline ('All partner institutions have internal deadlines'). The date was written as EXACT because it is stated explicitly, with a year, on two independent official pages that agree: /americans/application-deadlines and /canadians/application-deadlines, both reading 'January 31, 2027' for the 2027-28 competition, and /americans/how-to-apply ('by January 31st'). No conflict exists between these sources. If the record is meant to represent the whole Program rather than the open competition route, it should be re-scoped to two entries or downgraded to precision 'varies'; the deadline_date above must not be presented as the direct-exchange deadline.

field_mapping.deadline_display: Open competition: 31 January 2027 (2027-28 competition, opened 15 August 2026). Direct exchange: home institution's internal deadline, no single date.
